tensions.question: What authority gap remains between the signed price-amendment clause, the internal September rate instruction and INV-2025-086?
tensions.rule: price-amendment-authority@1.0.0: Apply the agreement’s requirement for a written change signed by both parties before treating an internally approved rate table or a later invoice as an amendment; distinguish internal effective date, service period and invoice issue date.
tensions.expected_inference: The internal table instructs use after 2025-09-08 but leaves customer signature, acceptance and amendment fields blank; the invoice issued 2025-10-08 for 2025-09 bills 3 Quarry Tower visits at GBP 24.67, net GBP 74.01. The rule requires both parties’ signatures, while the supplied internal approval does not document that bilateral act; no applicable contractual price is selected.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t001 is a tension because selecting the authority of a later internal rule requires the contract’s amendment test, not merely reading two competing amounts.

tensions.question: Do the overview and detailed total inside the same customer review agree on recovered mass for 2024-01 through 2025-04?
tensions.rule: same-report-total-label@1.0.0: Treat the overview’s period-summary recovered-mass label and the detailed total-recovered-mass label as claims for the same reporting scope within one document; subtract their printed tonne values with decimal arithmetic, then convert the gap at 1000 kg/t.
tensions.expected_inference: Page 3 prints 20.415 t and page 4 prints 20.405 t for the same period, a difference of 0.010 t (10 kg) between the printed tonne totals. This is not established as rounding or corrected by selecting either figure; the cross-document certificate-versus-table comparison is already primary in gl-d0035.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t002 remains an internal label-versus-total tension: two pages of one customer edition are not two documentary voices, and its exact assertion pair differs from gl-d0035.

tensions.question: How does the December 2024 working estimate compare with the amount the customer review calls actual recovered?
tensions.rule: estimate-to-actual-status@1.0.0: Compare quantities only while preserving their stated method; an account description of actual recovered and placement in weighed_kg do not supply missing primary weighing evidence; subtract decimal tonnes and use 1000 kg/t.
tensions.expected_inference: The preparation schedule estimates 0.673 t from nearby months; the customer schedule calls 0.719 t actual recovered, a difference of 0.046 t (46 kg). December receiving-scale evidence is absent and 2024 has no per-visit masses, so the latter remains the report’s account assertion rather than independently verified weighing; neither value is selected.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t003 requires the estimate-versus-actual evidence rule because the two quantities have different methods, rather than being two like-for-like observations.

tensions.question: What is the derived gap between the March estimate in the working note and the customer review’s published weighed mass?
tensions.rule: tonnes-to-kilograms-with-method@1.0.0: Convert the working estimate from tonnes to kilograms at 1000 kg/t, preserve estimated versus published-weighed status, and subtract using exact decimals; this cross-document inference does not recount the drafting succession within the preparation log.
tensions.expected_inference: The 1.287 t estimate becomes 1287 kg, compared with 1601.373 kg published as weighed: the difference is 314.373 kg. The March completed basis records 0.000 kg estimated and no not_weighed visits; neither quantity is silently replaced, and the within-log drafting sequence remains primary in gl-tr0011.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t004 requires both unit conversion and preservation of quantity status; its note-versus-customer-report pair is distinct from the within-log trajectory.

tensions.question: What quantity and arithmetic mismatch is present within the treatment line of INV-2025-070?
tensions.rule: invoice-label-quantity-arithmetic@1.0.0: Relate the description’s tonnage to the quantity column on the same invoice line, subtract in tonnes, convert at 1000 kg/t, and compare quantity times unit price with the printed net after rounding to GBP 0.01; arithmetic agreement does not authenticate material weight.
tensions.expected_inference: The description prints 1.091 t and the quantity column 1.137 t, a difference of 0.046 t (46 kg). The quantity-column product is 1.137 × GBP 177.29 = GBP 201.57873, rounding to the printed GBP 201.58; that match does not determine the correct physical mass or authorise credit or rebilling.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t005 is a single-document label-versus-amount tension; its independent collection-invoice estimation escalations are not added as extra planted tensions or written into the frozen escalations file.

tensions.question: What evidential gap separates the proposed June charges from the register’s closing position?
tensions.rule: planned-versus-executed-service@1.0.0: Apply the agreement’s completed-stop definition and record requirement to distinguish planned quantities from executed visits; a proposed run or undated preparation draft cannot by itself establish reopening or completed service after an operational closing entry.
tensions.expected_inference: The scenario and undated draft propose 52 June visits and GBP 1399.00 excluding tax after the register’s end-of-2025-05 closed/inactive entry. The draft records no completed June visit or June estimate, so the 52 planned visits cannot be accepted as executed service or reopening; the absence of evidence does not establish zero actual June activity.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t006 requires the rule separating plan status from execution evidence; the documents do not make incompatible observations at the same instant.

tensions.question: What legal-identity issue appears when the Station House carrier record is compared with the review’s 2025 billing attribution?
tensions.rule: operator-record-and-role-identity@1.0.0: Resolve a printed company record through an explicit legal-party statement, keep carrier trading name distinct from billing attribution, and require documented consent before inferring assignment from shared branding.
tensions.expected_inference: The ticket prints GreenLoop with operator record TEST-ORG-MWS-Q8T, which the agreement identifies as Mosswheel Services Ltd, whereas the review attributes 2025 billing to GreenLoop Collect Ltd, identified on its invoice by TEST-ORG-GLC-V6R. These are two distinct company records in different documentary roles; the shared trading name does not choose the responsible issuer or establish transfer.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t007 needs an explicit record-to-entity mapping and role distinction, so its gap is an identity inference rather than a direct dispute between like fields.

tensions.question: What late-payment terms require an authority decision when comparing the agreement with INV-2025-069?
tensions.rule: late-charge-rule-authority@1.0.0: Apply the agreement’s bilateral-amendment requirement to distinguish a contractual rule from invoice wording; compare annual rates in percentage points and fixed-fee terms without deciding legal applicability or an enforceable charge.
tensions.expected_inference: The agreement states 4.6 percent annual simple interest and no fixed recovery fee; INV-2025-069 states 8.7 percent and GBP 58.71 fixed recovery charge. The printed differences are 4.1 percentage points and a GBP 58.71 fixed fee versus none, while which rule applies remains for human decision.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t008 is retained because contractual applicability requires an authority rule; the later invoice does not establish a successor version of the agreement.

tensions.question: What execution-evidence gap remains for the two-site September invoice after the announced restart?
tensions.rule: announcement-invoice-versus-execution@1.0.0: Require completed-stop records to substantiate service, distinguish an announced restart and issued invoice from those records, and respect the ticket index’s January-May scope; the May-closure-to-September-announcement chronology is already primary in gl-tr0008 and is not scored again.
tensions.expected_inference: INV-2025-086 announces restart from 2025-09-09 and bills 6 Roast Kitchen plus 3 Quarry Tower visits, 9 billed visits in total, while the supplied 285-ticket index covers only 2025-01 through 2025-05. The nine September visits have invoice support but no September execution tickets in this dossier; actual service and restart authority remain unestablished rather than disproved.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t014 is narrowed to invoice/announcement-versus-execution evidence; gl-tr0008 retains sole ownership of the closed-to-restart chronology, so that transition is not another tension.

tensions.question: How much of the review-period mass is explicitly estimated, and what part of weighed_kg has primary visit-reading support?
tensions.rule: visit-mean-and-evidence-partition@1.0.0: Retain blank raw values and separate recorded zero from absence; sum nonnegative raw net readings for 2025-01 through 2025-04, estimate each missing net reading using its site’s same-month arithmetic mean (including recorded zeros) or immediately previous month when none exist, round each mean to 0.001 kg before applying it, and compare these results with the report columns; a prior-year account column is not primary weighing evidence.
tensions.expected_inference: The 230 January-April tickets give 4334.497 kg in net readings plus 2736.388 kg estimated for 63 unweighed visits, totalling 7070.885 kg with 38.70 percent estimated. Over the report schedule, 2736.388 kg is explicitly estimated (13.41 percent of 20404.885 kg), while weighed_kg carries 17668.497 kg (86.59 percent), including 13334.000 kg from the prior-year account schedule whose true measured/estimated split is unknown; the headline and certificate publish 20.415 t without that split, and the separate printed-total comparison remains outside this tension’s score.
tensions.why: Planted greenloop-t015 requires both the documented estimation algorithm and an evidence-status rule; naming a column weighed_kg does not establish that its entire contents were measured.
